goal: Critically compare three supplied Tarot educational posters with current Nilaza Tarot and Astrology, audit mobile-to-Admin AI data/configuration/trace/feedback parity, and update the detailed Vietnamese report and next implementation plan.
successCriteria: Each reference is assessed for useful structure, scientific limits, originality and novice usability without copying content or artwork.
Current implementation and gaps are grounded in source paths; source, historical tests and live verification are explicitly distinguished.
The next roadmap contains vertical slices across mobile, content, backend and Admin with dependencies, manager acceptance, privacy and rollback.
Only internal reports, this preflight record and sanitized audit evidence are edited; implementation remains unchanged.
untouchedSurfaces: All app, Admin, backend, data, prompt, artwork, test and dependency implementation files remain unchanged.
No live database, credentials, cloud targets, deployments, published content or user records are accessed or changed.

impact.entryPoint: Assess Tarot library/reading/Journal and Astrology library/chart/AI paths, plus Content Operations and AI Studio from source.
impact.dataWrite: Only internal Markdown reports, plan JSON and sanitized evidence metadata. No app state, content records or database changes.
impact.backendContract: Read-only assessment of prompt/model/content consumers, response schemas, trace correlation and feedback endpoints; no runtime calls.
impact.adminVisibility: Map supported fields from editor through draft/publish/resolver/trace, and explicitly identify unsupported or unverified capabilities.
impact.privacySafety: Supplied posters are untrusted reference material. Use public research and repository source only; no raw chat, birth profiles, logs or credentials.
impact.observability: Separate historical test evidence from this audit and current source findings. Plan privacy-preserving complaint-to-evaluation correlation.
impact.rollback: Documentation changes can be reverted individually while preserving all pre-existing dirty files and prior delivery evidence.
impact.surfacesIntentionallyUntouched: Runtime, assets, content, migrations, schemas, safety policy and live configuration are unchanged.
impact.agentHandoff: Root owns reports and evidence. Three reviewers read scoped source only: content/reference, Admin/runtime parity, and feedback/trace. No delegated writes or external operational actions.

canonicalContracts: packages/content/data/tarot-cards.json remains canonical card identity and meanings; tarot-learning-depth.json is a limited new local content source.
Current prompt bundle/compiler, astrology AI contract, Admin content bundle and model route SQL are audited as existing contracts; proposed revisions are not activated.
docs/BRAND_GUIDELINES.md and DESIGN.md remain layout/identity sources; attached posters are references, not product assets.
